The '''Dark Warbirds''' were a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] organization operating in the [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]]. They settled on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Uogo'cor/Legends|Uogo'cor]], enslaving the native [[Uogo]] until the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Uogo'cor suppression|destroyed]] all the pirate forces in the [[Uogo'cor system/Legends|Uogo'cor system]].
